--- title: "06 — Heterotrophy panel and trophic lineages" subtitle: "Frenemies euk metaT — curated grain 4, vent and non-vent sample units" author: "Hu Lab" date: last-modified format: html: toc: true toc-depth: 2 code-fold: show df-print: paged --- >SKH: streamlined 2026-11-07. 06 and 06b are now one script. Span rank, Δ+, field span, KEGG composition of span classes, expression-share panel views and module completeness were removed; presence/absence only. Backup: `scripts/_to_delete/pre_streamline_20261107/`. Render order: 05, 05b, 06, 07. # Questions Heterotrophy panel (`data/gene-lists/het_gene_reference.csv`, compiled by `scripts/00_build_gene_sets.R`) and trophic lineages: * **A. Where is each panel KO expressed?** The 05 habitat class of every panel KO. * **B. Which taxa carry each panel KO**, at vents, at non-vents, or at both (presence/absence). * **C. How similar are taxa's heterotrophy signals?** Pairwise Jaccard index of the sets of panel KOs each taxon carries, per habitat. * **D. Experimental phagotrophy genes.** Which KOs whose loss impairs phagotrophy *in a protist* are detected, and among which lineages? * **E. Lineage contrasts.** Do lineages with a documented symbiotic or parasitic lifestyle express a different share of each gene set than their free-living relatives? **Rules** (`config/params.yml`, shared with 05, 05b and 07): * *Detected* in a unit: ≥ 1 scaledTPM and ≥ 10 per million of the unit's retained expression. * *Taxon × KO pair present in a habitat*: detected in ≥ `pair_min_units` (2) units of that habitat. The pair table (`05b_taxon_ko_pairs.csv.gz`) is built once, in 05b. These are compositional data, so presence means a taxon's share of that KO clears detection, not a count of cells. * *Panel features*: a gene is matched by its KEGG KO; a gene with no KO is matched by Pfam domain (a transcript counts only when all of its Pfam domains belong to that gene). Panel categories are the trophic modes heterotrophy/phagotrophy, osmotrophy, symbiosis and parasitism (`scripts/00_build_gene_sets.R`). * Summed scaledTPM is used only as the sampling weight in the depth-matched rarefaction in section E. # Set up ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "scripts/_setup.R") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} PAIR_MIN_UNITS <- params$pair_min_units # 2, as in 05b MIN_TPM <- params$detect_min_tpm MIN_PER_MILLION <- params$detect_min_per_million OCC_MIN <- params$occupancy_min_frac N_RAREFY <- 999 # rarefaction draws per contrast MIN_SET_IN_POOL <- 3 # a set needs >= 3 member KOs across the two pools HABITAT_TABLE <- "output-tables/05_ko_habitat_class.csv" # from 05 TAXON_TABLE <- "output-tables/05_taxon_habitat.csv" # from 05 PAIR_TABLE <- "output-tables/05b_taxon_ko_pairs.csv.gz" # from 05b PAIRS_TABLE <- PAIR_TABLE HET_REFERENCE <- "data/gene-lists/het_gene_reference.csv" # scripts/00_build_gene_sets.R SETS_TABLE <- "data/gene-lists/trophic_gene_sets.csv" # from 00b HET_TABLE <- HET_REFERENCE EXPERIMENTAL <- "data/gene-lists/protist_phagotrophy_experimental.csv" VENT_ASSOCIATED <- c("vent_only", "vent_skewed", "shared") class_levels <- c("vent_only", "vent_skewed", "shared", "nonvent_skewed", "nonvent_only", "below_filter", "not_detected") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ko_hab <- read_csv(HABITAT_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) vent_kos <- ko_hab |> filter(habitat_class %in% VENT_ASSOCIATED) |> pull(ko_id) message(glue("{length(vent_kos)} vent-associated KOs (05)")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 853 vent-associated KOs (05) ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # panel: one row per feature x category x subcategory (a feature in two subcategories # counts in both), and one row per feature for the feature table. A feature is a KO, or # "pfam:" for a gene with no KO (2026-11-08); the column keeps the name `ko_id` # so every join below works on both. het_ref_panel <- read_csv(HET_REFERENCE, show_col_types = FALSE) |> filter(!is.na(subcategory)) het_long <- het_ref_panel |> distinct(ko_id = feature_id, match_type, category, subcategory, gene) het_ko <- het_long |> summarise(across(c(category, subcategory, gene), \(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse = " | ")), .by = c(ko_id, match_type)) het_ko |> count(category, match_type) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} message(glue("{nrow(het_ko)} panel features ({sum(het_ko$match_type == 'pfam')} matched by Pfam) | ", "{n_distinct(het_long$subcategory)} subcategories")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 174 panel features (2 matched by Pfam) | 25 subcategories ``` ::: ::: ## Pfam-matched genes Genes with no KEGG KO are matched by Pfam domain. eggNOG-mapper writes Pfam names in the `PFAMs` column, and a shared domain is not specific on its own (the saposin-like SapB domain also sits inside prosaposin and aspartic proteases), so a transcript is assigned to a Pfam gene only when **every** Pfam domain on it belongs to that gene. Taxon × feature pairs and habitat classes then follow the same detection and occupancy rules as KOs (05, 05b). The paired table holds only transcripts with a KO (`R/prep_paired.R`), so Pfam-only transcripts without any KO are not counted; `scripts/QC_pfam_panel_check.R` reports how much expression that leaves out. >SKH: added 2026-11-08. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pfam_genes <- het_ref_panel |> filter(match_type == "pfam") |> distinct(feature_id, pfam_name) |> mutate(domains = str_split(pfam_name, ";")) pfam_pairs <- tibble(cur_supergroup = character(), cur_phylum = character(), cur_L4 = character(), resolved_L4 = logical(), ko_id = character(), n_det_vent = integer(), n_det_nonvent = integer(), tpm_vent = double(), tpm_nonvent = double()) pfam_hab <- tibble(ko_id = character(), habitat_class = character()) if (nrow(pfam_genes)) { paired <- load_paired(fields = c("Gorda Ridge", "Von Damm", "Piccard"), depth = 4) units <- paired |> distinct(unit = sample_unit, vent_bin, field) # one Pfam feature per distinct PFAMs string, when all its domains belong to that gene pfam_key <- paired |> distinct(PFAMs) |> filter(!is.na(PFAMs), !PFAMs %in% c("", "-")) |> mutate(feature_id = map_chr(PFAMs, \(p) { d <- str_split_1(p, ",") hit <- pfam_genes$feature_id[map_lgl(pfam_genes$domains, \(f) all(d %in% f))] if (length(hit)) hit[1] else NA_character_ })) |> filter(!is.na(feature_id)) # unit totals come from the whole table, so detection uses the same denominator as KOs paired_pfam <- paired |> left_join(pfam_key, by = "PFAMs") pfam_pairs <- unit_expression(paired_pfam, c("cur_L4", "feature_id"), MIN_TPM, MIN_PER_MILLION) |> filter(!is.na(feature_id)) |> summarise(n_det_vent = sum(detected & vent_bin == "Vent"), n_det_nonvent = sum(detected & vent_bin != "Vent"), tpm_vent = sum(tpm[vent_bin == "Vent"]), tpm_nonvent = sum(tpm[vent_bin != "Vent"]), .by = c(cur_L4, feature_id)) |> filter(n_det_vent + n_det_nonvent > 0) |> left_join(paired |> distinct(cur_L4, cur_supergroup, cur_phylum, resolved_L4), by = "cur_L4") |> rename(ko_id = feature_id) pfam_ue <- unit_expression(paired_pfam, "feature_id", MIN_TPM, MIN_PER_MILLION) |> filter(!is.na(feature_id)) if (nrow(pfam_ue)) { pfam_hab <- habitat_occupancy(pfam_ue, units, "feature_id", OCC_MIN) |> transmute(ko_id = feature_id, habitat_class = as.character(habitat_class), occ_vent, occ_nonvent) } rm(paired, paired_pfam); invisible(gc()) } ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` [load_paired] data/processed/paired_L4.RData (built 2026-11-08 11:40; 324,868 rows) ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} pfam_key_summary <- if (exists("pfam_key")) count(pfam_key, feature_id, name = "n_pfam_strings") else NULL pfam_key_summary ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} pfam_hab ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} message(glue("{n_distinct(pfam_pairs$ko_id)} Pfam features detected in ", "{nrow(pfam_pairs)} taxon x feature pairs")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 2 Pfam features detected in 3 taxon x feature pairs ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # KO pairs from 05b plus the Pfam pairs: the table every panel view below reads panel_pairs <- bind_rows(read_csv(PAIR_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE), pfam_pairs) ``` ::: # A. Where is each panel KO expressed? The 05 habitat class of every panel KO. `below_filter` KOs are detected somewhere but clear the occupancy rule in neither habitat; `not_detected` KOs are absent from the 05 table. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} het_habitat <- het_ko |> left_join(bind_rows(ko_hab |> select(ko_id, habitat_class, occ_vent, occ_nonvent), pfam_hab), by = "ko_id") |> mutate(habitat_class = factor(replace_na(habitat_class, "not_detected"), levels = class_levels)) het_habitat |> count(habitat_class, .drop = FALSE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} het_habitat_subcat <- het_long |> left_join(het_habitat |> select(ko_id, habitat_class), by = "ko_id") |> count(subcategory, habitat_class, .drop = FALSE) |> pivot_wider(names_from = habitat_class, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) het_habitat_subcat ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: > For results: how many panel KOs fall in each habitat class, and which subcategories hold the vent-associated ones. # B. Which taxa carry each panel KO, at vents and non-vents Coverage is uneven across taxa and across habitats (13 vent units, 6 non-vent units), so this view is presence/absence only. A taxon carries a panel KO in a habitat when the taxon × KO pair is detected in ≥ `pair_min_units` (2) units of that habitat (detection rule as in 05b: ≥ 1 scaledTPM and ≥ 10 per million of the unit's retained expression). The count at ≥ 1 unit is reported next to it, so the effect of the rule is visible. All panel KOs detected anywhere are included, not only the vent-associated ones, so non-vent-only pairs are kept. Each pair is then labelled vent only, non-vent only, or both. A KO in two subcategories appears in both. >SKH: presence/absence by habitat added 2026-10-26; the unit rule was changed from 1 to `pair_min_units` (2) on 2026-11-07. Reads 05b's taxon × KO pair table. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} PRESENCE_MIN_UNITS <- PAIR_MIN_UNITS # present in a habitat = pair detected in >= 2 units of that habitat presence_lab <- c(vent_only = "Vent only", nonvent_only = "Non-vent only", both = "Vent and non-vent") presence_pal <- c(vent_only = "#b74a70", nonvent_only = "#346D6E", both = "grey45") taxon_groups <- read_csv(TAXON_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |> distinct(cur_L4, cur_group) het_presence <- panel_pairs |> filter(ko_id %in% het_ko$ko_id) |> mutate(in_vent = n_det_vent >= PRESENCE_MIN_UNITS, in_nonvent = n_det_nonvent >= PRESENCE_MIN_UNITS) |> filter(in_vent | in_nonvent) |> mutate(presence = case_when(in_vent & in_nonvent ~ "both", in_vent ~ "vent_only", TRUE ~ "nonvent_only"), presence = factor(presence, levels = names(presence_lab)), taxon = taxon_label_unique(cur_L4)) |> left_join(taxon_groups, by = "cur_L4") |> inner_join(het_long, by = "ko_id", relationship = "many-to-many") |> select(cur_group, cur_L4, taxon, resolved_L4, category, subcategory, ko_id, gene, n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent, presence) # one row per taxon x KO for counting (subcategory duplicates removed) het_pairs <- het_presence |> distinct(cur_group, cur_L4, taxon, ko_id, presence) message(glue("{n_distinct(het_pairs$ko_id)} of {nrow(het_ko)} panel KOs carried by ", "{n_distinct(het_pairs$cur_L4)} taxa in {nrow(het_pairs)} taxon x KO pairs")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 127 of 174 panel KOs carried by 95 taxa in 630 taxon x KO pairs ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} het_pairs |> count(presence) |> mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # the same count when one unit is enough (sensitivity to the unit rule) presence_sensitivity <- map_dfr(c(1, PAIR_MIN_UNITS), \(m) { panel_pairs |> filter(ko_id %in% het_ko$ko_id) |> mutate(in_vent = n_det_vent >= m, in_nonvent = n_det_nonvent >= m) |> filter(in_vent | in_nonvent) |> mutate(presence = case_when(in_vent & in_nonvent ~ "both", in_vent ~ "vent_only", TRUE ~ "nonvent_only")) |> count(presence) |> mutate(frac = round(n / sum(n), 3), min_units = m, .before = 1) }) presence_sensitivity ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # per taxon: how many panel KOs it carries in each habitat state het_presence_taxa <- het_pairs |> count(cur_group, taxon, presence) |> pivot_wider(names_from = presence, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |> mutate(n_kos = rowSums(across(any_of(names(presence_lab))))) |> arrange(desc(n_kos)) het_presence_taxa |> head(15) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: > For results: how many taxon × KO pairs are vent only, non-vent only, or both; which taxa carry the most panel KOs and in which habitat. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} grp <- unique(het_presence$cur_group) grp_levels <- c(intersect(SUPERGROUP_0_ordering, grp), setdiff(grp, SUPERGROUP_0_ordering)) taxon_order_pa <- het_pairs |> count(taxon, name = "n_kos") |> arrange(desc(n_kos)) |> pull(taxon) ko_order_pa <- het_pairs |> count(ko_id, name = "n_taxa") |> arrange(desc(n_taxa)) |> pull(ko_id) pa_df <- het_presence |> mutate(cur_group = factor(cur_group, levels = grp_levels), taxon = factor(taxon, levels = rev(taxon_order_pa)), ko_id = factor(ko_id, levels = ko_order_pa), subcategory = str_wrap(subcategory, 14)) |> # one label per KO, from the collapsed gene names left_join(select(het_ko, ko_id, gene_all = gene), by = "ko_id") |> mutate(gene_short = str_remove(gene_all, " \\(.*$")) |> distinct(cur_group, taxon, subcategory, ko_id, gene_short, presence) |> arrange(ko_id) |> mutate(ko_lab = forcats::fct_inorder(as.character(glue("{gene_short} ({ko_id})")))) fig_het_presence <- ggplot(pa_df, aes(ko_lab, taxon, fill = presence)) + geom_tile(color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.2) + scale_fill_manual(values = presence_pal, labels = presence_lab, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) + facet_grid(cur_group ~ subcategory, scales = "free", space = "free") + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 7) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "top", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5), strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, size = 6), strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, size = 6)) fig_het_presence # ggsave("figures/06-het-presence.svg", fig_het_presence, width = 16, height = 22) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](06-heterotrophy_files/figure-html/fig-het-presence-1.png){#fig-het-presence width=2112} ::: ::: # C. How similar are taxa's heterotrophy signals? Pairwise Jaccard, vent and non-vent The presence/absence view above shows which taxon carries which KO. To see which taxa carry *the same* KOs, each taxon is reduced to the set of panel KOs it carries in a habitat (same detection rule as above), and every pair of taxa is compared with the Jaccard index: shared KOs / KOs carried by either taxon (0 = no KO in common, 1 = identical sets). Shared absences do not count, which matters because most taxa carry only a few panel KOs. Vent and non-vent are computed separately; a pair detected in both habitats counts in both. The diagonal is masked. Taxon labels give the number of panel KOs the taxon carries in that habitat, because Jaccard is sensitive to repertoire size (a taxon with 2 KOs can reach at most 2 / n of a larger taxon's set). ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} TAXON_MIN_KOS_PANEL <- 1 # taxa kept in the whole-panel comparison TAXON_MIN_KOS_SUBCAT <- 2 # taxa kept within a subcategory (Jaccard on 1 KO is degenerate) SUBCAT_MIN_KOS <- 5 # subcategories plotted (detected KOs in that habitat); all go in the csv hab_levels <- c("vent", "nonvent") hab_lab <- c(vent = "Vent", nonvent = "Non-vent") hab_col <- c(vent = presence_pal[["vent_only"]], nonvent = presence_pal[["nonvent_only"]]) sim_group_levels <- c(intersect(SUPERGROUP_0_ordering, unique(het_presence$cur_group)), setdiff(unique(het_presence$cur_group), SUPERGROUP_0_ordering)) # taxon x KO pairs detected in one habitat (one row per subcategory a KO belongs to) hab_pairs <- function(hab) { het_presence |> filter(.data[[paste0("n_det_", hab)]] >= PRESENCE_MIN_UNITS) |> distinct(cur_group, taxon, ko_id, subcategory) } # Jaccard between every pair of taxa; df needs columns taxon and ko_id jaccard_long <- function(df) { m <- df |> distinct(taxon, ko_id) |> mutate(carries = 1L) |> pivot_wider(names_from = ko_id, values_from = carries, values_fill = 0L) |> column_to_rownames("taxon") |> as.matrix() shared <- m %*% t(m) # KOs in common n_kos <- diag(shared) # KOs per taxon jac <- shared / (outer(n_kos, n_kos, "+") - shared) as_tibble(jac, rownames = "taxon_x") |> pivot_longer(-taxon_x, names_to = "taxon_y", values_to = "jaccard") } # ---- whole panel ---- panel_sim <- function(hab) { hp <- hab_pairs(hab) |> distinct(cur_group, taxon, ko_id) |> filter(n_distinct(ko_id) >= TAXON_MIN_KOS_PANEL, .by = taxon) info <- hp |> summarise(n_kos = n_distinct(ko_id), .by = c(cur_group, taxon)) |> mutate(cur_group = factor(cur_group, levels = sim_group_levels)) |> arrange(cur_group, desc(n_kos), taxon) |> mutate(lab = forcats::fct_inorder(as.character(glue("{taxon} ({n_kos})")))) jaccard_long(hp) |> left_join(rename_with(info, \(x) paste0(x, "_x")), by = "taxon_x") |> left_join(rename_with(info, \(x) paste0(x, "_y")), by = "taxon_y") |> mutate(jaccard = if_else(taxon_x == taxon_y, NA_real_, jaccard)) } sim_panel <- map(set_names(hab_levels), panel_sim) |> list_rbind(names_to = "habitat") # ---- within each subcategory ---- subcat_sim <- function(hab) { hab_pairs(hab) |> mutate(n_kos_subcat = n_distinct(ko_id), .by = subcategory) |> filter(n_distinct(ko_id) >= TAXON_MIN_KOS_SUBCAT, .by = c(subcategory, taxon)) |> filter(n_distinct(taxon) >= 3, .by = subcategory) |> nest(.by = c(subcategory, n_kos_subcat)) |> mutate(jac = map(data, jaccard_long)) |> select(-data) |> unnest(jac) } sim_subcat <- map(set_names(hab_levels), subcat_sim) |> list_rbind(names_to = "habitat") # one row per subcategory x habitat, all subcategories (plotted or not) sim_summary <- sim_subcat |> filter(taxon_x < taxon_y) |> # each unordered pair once summarise(n_taxa = n_distinct(c(taxon_x, taxon_y)), n_pairs = n(), frac_pairs_shared = mean(jaccard > 0), median_jaccard = median(jaccard), .by = c(habitat, subcategory, n_kos_subcat)) |> arrange(habitat, desc(n_kos_subcat)) sim_panel |> filter(taxon_x < taxon_y) |> summarise(n_taxa = n_distinct(c(taxon_x, taxon_y)), frac_pairs_shared = mean(jaccard > 0), median_jaccard = median(jaccard), .by = habitat) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} sim_summary ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: > For results: fraction of taxon pairs sharing ≥ 1 panel KO and the median Jaccard, vent vs non-vent (`sim_panel` summary above); which supergroups' taxa resemble each other most. > Supplemental: the full matrices (every taxon). Each is followed by a compact version restricted to taxa carrying at least `SIM_MIN_KOS_COMPACT` panel KOs, which is the main-text candidate; a supergroup-level summary follows both. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} plot_panel_sim <- function(hab, min_kos = 1, axis_size = 4) { d <- filter(sim_panel, habitat == hab, n_kos_x >= min_kos, n_kos_y >= min_kos) ggplot(d, aes(lab_x, lab_y, fill = jaccard)) + geom_tile(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.1) + scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = hab_col[[hab]], limits = c(0, 1), na.value = "grey90", name = "Jaccard") + scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) + facet_grid(cur_group_y ~ cur_group_x, scales = "free", space = "free") + labs(title = glue("{hab_lab[[hab]]}: pairwise similarity of heterotrophy KO repertoires"), subtitle = if (min_kos > 1) glue("Taxa carrying at least {min_kos} panel KOs in this habitat"), x = NULL, y = NULL) + theme_minimal(base_size = 7) + theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.spacing = unit(0.15, "lines"), legend.position = "top", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = axis_size), axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_size), strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0, size = 6), strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0, size = 6)) } fig_het_sim_vent <- plot_panel_sim("vent") fig_het_sim_vent # ggsave("figures/06-het-similarity-vent.svg", fig_het_sim_vent, width = 16, height = 16) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](06-heterotrophy_files/figure-html/fig-het-similarity-1.png){#fig-het-similarity width=2112} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} SIM_MIN_KOS_COMPACT <- 10 # taxa kept in the compact figures and the supergroup summary fig_het_sim_vent_compact <- plot_panel_sim("vent", min_kos = SIM_MIN_KOS_COMPACT, axis_size = 6) fig_het_sim_vent_compact # ggsave("figures/06-het-similarity-vent-compact.svg", fig_het_sim_vent_compact, width = 8, height = 8) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](06-heterotrophy_files/figure-html/fig-het-similarity-vent-compact-1.png){#fig-het-similarity-vent-compact width=768} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} fig_het_sim_nonvent <- plot_panel_sim("nonvent") fig_het_sim_nonvent # ggsave("figures/06-het-similarity-nonvent.svg", fig_het_sim_nonvent, width = 16, height = 16) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](06-heterotrophy_files/figure-html/fig-het-similarity-nonvent-1.png){#fig-het-similarity-nonvent width=2112} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} fig_het_sim_nonvent_compact <- plot_panel_sim("nonvent", min_kos = SIM_MIN_KOS_COMPACT, axis_size = 6) fig_het_sim_nonvent_compact # ggsave("figures/06-het-similarity-nonvent-compact.svg", fig_het_sim_nonvent_compact, width = 11, height = 11) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](06-heterotrophy_files/figure-html/fig-het-similarity-nonvent-compact-1.png){#fig-het-similarity-nonvent-compact width=1056} ::: ::: Supergroup level: the mean Jaccard over all pairs of taxa between two supergroups (within a supergroup, over pairs of distinct taxa). Same taxa as the compact figures (at least `SIM_MIN_KOS_COMPACT` KOs). A blank tile means the supergroup has a single taxon, so there are no within-supergroup pairs. Lineage inputs (D and E) Pairs are kept when detected in ≥ `pair_min_units` units of either habitat. Gene sets come from `data/gene-lists/trophic_gene_sets.csv` (`scripts/00_build_gene_sets.R`): KEGG level-C pathways in Transport and catabolism, Signal transduction, Cell growth and death and Cell motility, restricted to the pathways kept for protists in `data/gene-lists/kegg_levelC_curation.csv`; the Burns et al. 2018 phagocytosis / photosynthesis / prototrophy families; and the protist experimental set. The curated heterotrophy subcategories are added so they can be read against the same contrasts. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pairs <- read_csv(PAIRS_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(phylum = str_squish(str_extract(cur_phylum, "[^;]+$")), lineage = str_squish(str_extract(cur_L4, "[^;]+$")), tpm_total = tpm_vent + tpm_nonvent) |> filter(n_det_vent >= PAIR_MIN_UNITS | n_det_nonvent >= PAIR_MIN_UNITS) trophic_sets <- read_csv(SETS_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) het_ref <- read_csv(HET_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) experimental <- read_csv(EXPERIMENTAL, show_col_types = FALSE) message(glue("{nrow(pairs)} detected lineage x KO pairs | {n_distinct(pairs$cur_L4)} lineages | ", "{n_distinct(pairs$ko_id)} KOs")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 10783 detected lineage x KO pairs | 186 lineages | 3642 KOs ``` ::: ::: # D. Experimental phagotrophy genes One row per gene × KO. `n_lineages` counts class-level lineages with a detected pair; `top_lineages` lists up to five, highest summed scaledTPM first. `in_vent_universe` is whether 07 ranks the KO at all; `habitat_class` is the KO's 05 class. >SKH: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ko_names <- trophic_sets |> distinct(ko_id, ko_name) experimental_detection <- experimental |> separate_longer_delim(ko_id, ";") |> mutate(ko_id = na_if(str_squish(ko_id), "")) |> left_join(ko_names, by = "ko_id") |> left_join(pairs |> summarise(n_lineages = n_distinct(cur_L4), top_lineages = paste(head(lineage[order(-tpm_total)], 5), collapse = " | "), .by = ko_id), by = "ko_id") |> left_join(ko_hab |> select(ko_id, habitat_class), by = "ko_id") |> mutate(n_lineages = replace_na(n_lineages, 0L), in_vent_universe = habitat_class %in% VENT_ASSOCIATED) |> select(gene_label, organism, ko_id, ko_name, n_lineages, top_lineages, in_vent_universe, habitat_class, evidence, citation) experimental_detection ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}

Lineage contrasts ## Lineage groups Fixed before looking at the data, from the literature; edit `lineage_groups` to change membership. Each contrast compares lineages with a documented lifestyle (`focal`) against free-living relatives in the same phylum (`reference`). Lineages not listed (e.g. "(unres.)" bins, *Mesodinium*) stay out of both sides. * **Ciliates.** Armophorea, Muranotrichea and Parablepharismea form a clade of obligate anaerobes that all host prokaryotic symbionts (Rotterová et al. 2020, *Curr Biol* 30:2037–2050); Plagiopylea are anaerobic ciliates with prokaryotic symbionts (Fenchel et al. 1977, *J Protozool* 24:154–163), including a denitrifying endosymbiont (Graf et al. 2021, *Nature* 591:445–450). * **Syndiniales.** Parasitoids of other protists (John et al. 2019, *Sci Adv* 5:eaav1110; Farhat et al. 2018, *Front Microbiol* 9:2251), against free-living dinoflagellate lineages. Dinophyceae includes mixotrophs and a few parasites, so the reference is not purely free-living. * **Myzozoa.** Apicomplexans, gregarines, squirmids and perkinsids (parasites) against chromerids and colpodellids (free-living photosynthetic or predatory relatives; Woo et al. 2015, *eLife* 4:e06974; Mathur et al. 2019, *Curr Biol* 29:2936–2941; Leander et al. 2003, *J Eukaryot Microbiol* 50:334–340; Hoppenrath and Leander 2009, *J Eukaryot Microbiol* 56:251–256). >SKH: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} ciliate_reference <- c("Colpodea", "Heterotrichea", "Litostomatea", "Nassophorea", "Oligohymenophorea", "Phyllopharyngea", "Prostomatea", "Spirotrichea") myzozoa_parasite <- c("Aconoidasia", "Apicomplexa (unres.)", "Ancora", "Cardiosporidium", "Cephaloidophora", "Digyalum", "Eleutheroschizon", "Filipodium", "Hammondia", "Lankesteria", "Platyproteum", "Polyplicarium", "Rhytidocystis", "Selenidium", "Siedleckia", "Squirmida (unres.)", "Perkinsea (unres.)", "Perkinsida") myzozoa_freeliving <- c("Alphamonadaceae", "Chromeraceae", "Chromerida_X", "Colpodellaceae", "Colpodellida (unres.)", "Colponema", "Colponemidia (unres.)", "Vitrellaceae") lineage_groups <- bind_rows( tibble(contrast = "Ciliates: anaerobic, symbiont-bearing vs. other classes", phylum = "Alveolata-Ciliophora", role = "focal", lineage = c("Armophorea", "Muranotrichea", "Parablepharismea", "Plagiopylea")), tibble(contrast = "Ciliates: anaerobic, symbiont-bearing vs. other classes", phylum = "Alveolata-Ciliophora", role = "reference", lineage = ciliate_reference), # Syndiniales: every lineage of the curated Syndiniales phylum, plus Amoebophryaceae # wherever the curation placed it pairs |> filter(phylum == "Alveolata-Syndiniales") |> distinct(phylum, lineage) |> mutate(contrast = "Syndiniales vs. free-living dinoflagellates", role = "focal"), tibble(contrast = "Syndiniales vs. free-living dinoflagellates", phylum = "Alveolata-Dinophyta", role = "focal", lineage = "Amoebophryaceae"), tibble(contrast = "Syndiniales vs. free-living dinoflagellates", phylum = "Alveolata-Dinophyta", role = "reference", lineage = c("Dinophyceae", "Noctilucales", "Oxyrrhinales")), tibble(contrast = "Myzozoa: parasites vs. free-living relatives", phylum = "Alveolata-Myzozoa", role = "focal", lineage = myzozoa_parasite), tibble(contrast = "Myzozoa: parasites vs. free-living relatives", phylum = "Alveolata-Myzozoa", role = "reference", lineage = myzozoa_freeliving)) stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(lineage_groups[c("contrast", "phylum", "lineage")])) grouped_pairs <- pairs |> inner_join(lineage_groups, by = c("phylum", "lineage"), relationship = "many-to-many") # KO pool per side: union of member lineages, weight = summed scaledTPM pools <- grouped_pairs |> summarise(weight = pmax(sum(tpm_total), 1e-9), # a detected pair always counts n_lineages = n_distinct(cur_L4), .by = c(contrast, role, ko_id)) pool_sizes <- pools |> summarise(n_kos = n_distinct(ko_id), .by = c(contrast, role)) |> left_join(grouped_pairs |> summarise(lineages = paste(sort(unique(lineage)), collapse = ", "), .by = c(contrast, role)), by = c("contrast", "role")) pool_sizes ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}

````` ::: ::: ## Depth-matched comparison A lineage pool with few detected KOs holds mostly its most highly expressed ones, so a raw "share of the repertoire in set X" mixes biology with sequencing depth. Here both pools are **rarefied to the same number of KOs** (the smaller pool's size), drawing KOs without replacement with probability proportional to their summed scaledTPM, which mimics detection at a lower depth. For each set and draw: `diff = members in focal − members in reference`. Reported per set: median `diff`, its 2.5–97.5% range over `N_RAREFY` draws, and `frac_focal_higher`. **This is a rarefaction summary, not a hypothesis test**: an interval that excludes 0 means the difference holds at matched depth, nothing more, and with pools of tens of KOs it should be read as exploratory. >SKH: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} rarefied_contrast <- function(pool_focal, pool_ref, sets, n_draws = N_RAREFY) { n_draw <- min(nrow(pool_focal), nrow(pool_ref)) set_ids <- sets |> filter(ko_id %in% c(pool_focal$ko_id, pool_ref$ko_id)) |> add_count(set_source, set_name, name = "n_in_pools") |> filter(n_in_pools >= MIN_SET_IN_POOL) if (!nrow(set_ids) || n_draw < 2) return(tibble()) # KO x set incidence, so one draw is a single colSums() set_keys <- set_ids |> distinct(set_source, set_name) |> mutate(key = paste(set_source, set_name, sep = " :: ")) all_kos <- union(pool_focal$ko_id, pool_ref$ko_id) incidence <- matrix(0L, length(all_kos), nrow(set_keys), dimnames = list(all_kos, set_keys$key)) incidence[cbind(set_ids$ko_id, paste(set_ids$set_source, set_ids$set_name, sep = " :: "))] <- 1L draw_counts <- function(pool) { replicate(n_draws, colSums(incidence[sample(pool$ko_id, n_draw, prob = pool$weight), , drop = FALSE])) } diffs <- matrix(draw_counts(pool_focal) - draw_counts(pool_ref), nrow = nrow(set_keys)) # member KO ids on each side, so overlap between KEGG maps is visible # (the same cathepsin or V-ATPase can sit in Lysosome, Phagocytosis and Apoptosis) members_in <- function(pool) { map_chr(set_keys$key, \(k) paste(sort(intersect(pool$ko_id, all_kos[incidence[, k] == 1L])), collapse = " | ")) } set_keys |> mutate(n_rarefied = n_draw, in_focal_pool = colSums(incidence[pool_focal$ko_id, , drop = FALSE]), in_ref_pool = colSums(incidence[pool_ref$ko_id, , drop = FALSE]), focal_member_kos = members_in(pool_focal), ref_member_kos = members_in(pool_ref), diff_median = apply(diffs, 1, median), diff_lo = apply(diffs, 1, quantile, 0.025), diff_hi = apply(diffs, 1, quantile, 0.975), frac_focal_higher = rowMeans(diffs > 0), frac_ref_higher = rowMeans(diffs < 0), interval_excludes_0 = diff_lo > 0 | diff_hi < 0) |> select(-key) } set.seed(params$seed) contrast_results <- pools |> nest(.by = contrast) |> mutate(result = map(data, \(d) rarefied_contrast( pool_focal = d |> filter(role == "focal"), pool_ref = d |> filter(role == "reference"), sets = contrast_sets))) |> select(contrast, result) |> unnest(result) |> arrange(contrast, desc(interval_excludes_0), desc(abs(diff_median))) message(glue("{nrow(contrast_results)} contrast x set rows | ", "{sum(contrast_results$interval_excludes_0)} with a 95% rarefaction interval excluding 0")) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` 98 contrast x set rows | 28 with a 95% rarefaction interval excluding 0 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} contrast_results |> filter(interval_excludes_0) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}

Small pools (tens of KOs) limit what any set can show. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} contrast_results |> filter(interval_excludes_0) |> mutate(set_label = fct_reorder(paste0(set_name, " [", set_source, "]"), diff_median)) |> ggplot(aes(x = diff_median, y = set_label)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey50") + geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = diff_lo, xmax = diff_hi), width = 0.2, orientation = "y") + geom_point(size = 2) + facet_wrap(~contrast, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") + labs(x = "Member KOs, focal − reference (rarefied to equal pool size; median, 95% range)", y = NULL) + theme_bw(base_size = 10) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](06-heterotrophy_files/figure-html/fig-rarefied-contrast-1.png){#fig-rarefied-contrast width=864} ::: ::: #
